Own step:
This is consistent with all previous checks. The eight fixes are verified, the build compiles, and the project is in a clean state.

## Final Synthesis: `tmp/mcgo/` — Complete Status

**Project:** MiniCraft — a Minecraft-style game in Go using Ebitengine v2.

**Build:** `go build ./...` passes with zero errors.

**Files on disk (all verified):**
```
tmp/mcgo/
├── go.mod
├── go.sum
├── main.go                  (5174 bytes)
├── block/block.go           (1486 bytes)
├── camera/camera.go         (2453 bytes) — unused, kept as-is
├── player/player.go         (3951 bytes)
├── player/interaction.go    (2334 bytes)
├── render/render.go         (10704 bytes)
└── world/
    ├── chunk.go             (2025 bytes)
    ├── generator.go         (2770 bytes)
    └── world.go             (4530 bytes)
```

### All 8 Code Review Fixes — Verified in Source

| # | Fix | Status |
|---|-----|--------|
| 1 | `Indices` changed from `[]uint16` → `[]uint32` to prevent vertex overflow (>65536) | ✓ |
| 2 | Duplicate back-face culling block removed from `render.go` | ✓ |
| 3 | `fillTriangle` bottom-half bug fixed: correct edge slopes `mx1` (y2→y3) and `mx2` (y1→y3), `sx2` properly interpolated to y2 | ✓ |
| 4 | Dead `if/else` block removed from `collides()` in `player.go` | ✓ |
| 5 | Redundant `castRay` wrapper removed; unified `castRay()` returns `HitResult` directly | ✓ |
| 6 | Right-click placement now uses full AABB overlap test (0.3×1.8 hitbox) instead of simple point check | ✓ |
| 7 | `UnloadFarChunks()` added to `world.go`, called in `Update()` with `unloadDist = renderDist + 2`; stale meshes cleaned | ✓ |
| 8 | `render.go.fix` temporary file absent (never existed on this mount, fix applied to `render.go`) | ✓ |

### Remaining Caveats (Not Addressed — Minor)

1. **`camera` package is fully unused** (~110 lines of dead code, never imported). Safe to delete or keep as scaffolding.
2. **`blockColors` duplicated** in `render.go` vs `block.Properties` — both contain the same colour data. Could refactor to read from `block.Properties` exclusively.
3. **Water blocks are invisible** — `if bt == block.Air || bt == block.Water { continue }` skips water entirely in mesh building.
4. **`drawFog` is an empty stub** — no fog effect implemented.
5. **Tree placement uses narrow height range** (height >= 30 && height < 34) — may miss valid terrain positions on variable terrain.
6. **No dirty-chunk optimisation list** — every frame iterates all loaded chunks checking the `Dirty` flag, instead of maintaining a separate dirty list for O(1) access.

None of these remaining items affect compilation or basic gameplay functionality. The project is structurally sound, all high-priority bugs from the original review have been resolved.

END_STEP
